newsitem.title: CANADA: C$50 million added to FCC farm loan fund - Goodale.
newsitem.headline: C$50 million added to FCC farm loan fund - Goodale.

text.p: C$50 million were added to the federal lending agency Farm Credit Corporation's loan account for Canadian farmers, Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale said in a statement.
"The Farm Credit Corporation will be provided with C$50 million in additional capital," Goodale said.
The increased funding was part of Canada's 1997/98 budget submitted to the House of Commons on Tuesday. The additional money will be applied to the FCC's general pool account.
"Consideration will be given to new equity instruments as potential tools to augment existing loan programs," he said.
The FCC approves more than C$1 billion in farm loans each year and has a loan portfolio of more than C$4 billion.
